name: Mito

queries.query: Mito City Ibaraki official cadastral map parcel map GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery found Mito City's official open-data page for cadastral parcel-number compilation maps (地形地番集成編纂図). The city page identifies a downloadable ZIP and the Taxation Division as the responsible department; no public interactive parcel API was exposed by the page.

queries.query: 水戸市 地籍図 地番図 GIS 公開 マップ
queries.result: 公式の水戸市ページで地形地番集成編纂図（地番図）のオープンデータ公開を確認した。説明では土地の形状・境界・求積・登記・権利関係の確認には使用できないとされ、GISソフトが必要。ZIPにはCSV、DBF、PRJ、SHP、SHXが格納されるが、今回の環境ではバイナリ取得が完了せず、匿名のID+形状レスポンスやフィールド実データは確認できなかった。

registryEvidence.custodian: Mito City (水戸市), specifically the Taxation Division's fixed-assets tax section (資産税課資産税係), is identified on the city's official cadastral-map publication as the responsible local custodian. Ibaraki Prefecture's Digital Map is a broader prefecture/municipality shared GIS lead, not the primary local cadastral custodian.
registryEvidence.scope: A real local cadastral-map/open-data publication is evidenced. The city expressly limits the map to approximate locations of parcel numbers and disclaims use for boundaries, area calculation, registration, rights, or certification. This qualifies registryFound but does not qualify an admitted runtime adapter.

parcelDiscovery.source: Mito City official open-data cadastral-map publication; source package was advertised but no bounded feature response was safely retrieved in this attempt.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 official city page. It states the dataset is a cadastral parcel-number compilation map, last updated 2026-01-01, CC-BY, Japanese, with Taxation Division responsible; it advertises a ZIP containing CSV/DBF/PRJ/SHP/SHX. No inline schema or feature response was present.
HTTP 200 official city procedure page. It confirms public inspection/copy procedures and open-data publication, but explicitly limits the map and provides no parcel API response.

Official page link resolved to this ZIP; web retrieval reported unsupported application/zip content and the local curl attempt could not resolve the host. No archive contents, schema, CRS, native IDs, or geometries were retained.
Returned as an official Ibaraki Digital Map lead from Mito's urban-planning search results, but no anonymous Mito parcel-vector response was qualified in this attempt.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as an absence test. No exact-point parcel query was issued because no public feature endpoint or safely retrievable vector response was exposed. A download failure, map extent miss, timeout, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide absence.

uncertainty: The local custodian and public data publication are evidenced, but the archive could not be inspected for actual native identity fields, CRS, geometry validity, or citywide coverage.
The published map is approximate and explicitly not suitable for boundary, area, registration, or rights determinations.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No sample GeoJSON was written because no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was returned.
Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission.
